description_en: Deletes a stream pulling-to-pushing task by calling DeleteLivePullToPush
description_zh: 调用DeleteLivePullToPush删除拉流转推任务
kebab_example: aliyun live delete-live-pull-to-push --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id 3efb43c5-18ff-49eb-92a6-005f65210000 --biz-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteLivePullToPush

parameters.description_en:
The region where the task is started. Valid values:

- ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
- ap-southeast-5 (Indonesia)
- cn-beijing (Beijing)
- cn-shanghai (Shanghai).

- ap-southeast-5（印度尼西亚）
- cn-beijing（北京）
- cn-shanghai（上海）
